darwin-x64/ffmpeg.note: Cross-compiled on Apple Silicon by scripts/build-ffmpeg-sidecar-mac.sh x64, which adds --enable-cross-compile --target-os=darwin --cc='clang -arch x86_64' to the shared configuration above. Requires nasm on the build host (x86 SIMD) and Rosetta 2 to run the licence-banner check; neither is linked into the result, which depends only on /usr/lib and /System/Library.
